questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No honking near railroad crossing
Trains do not sound their horn at this crossing
Horn required before crossing tracks
Noise restriction zone — reduce speed

questions.correctAnswerText: Trains do not sound their horn at this crossing
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a quiet zone where trains do not routinely sound their horns when approaching the crossing. Drivers must be extra cautious since there will be no audible warning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trains have the right of way at all crossings
Stop and wait for the train to move
Do not pass around stopped trains
Sound your horn before crossing tracks

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not pass around stopped trains
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers not to go around a stopped train. A train may extend across more tracks or another train may be approaching from the other direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Intersection ahead — yield to cross traffic
Railroad crossing — yield to trains
No passing zone at railroad
Road crosses active rail yard

questions.explanation: The railroad crossbuck is placed at railroad-highway crossings. It means you must yield the right of way to trains. Look both ways, listen, and be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Bus stop ahead
Train depot — no public access
Park-and-ride facility ahead
Light rail transit station ahead

questions.explanation: This sign alerts drivers that a light rail transit station is ahead. Watch for pedestrians crossing to reach the station and for light rail vehicles entering or leaving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Train station entrance ahead
Railroad crossing ahead — be prepared to stop
Railroad maintenance zone
Road closed at railroad crossing

questions.correctAnswerText: Railroad crossing ahead — be prepared to stop
questions.explanation: This advance warning sign alerts drivers that a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down, look and listen for trains, and be prepared to stop if a train is approaching.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway-rail crossing on the right ahead
Right turn leads to a train station
Highway exit on the right
Parallel road ahead on the right

questions.correctAnswerText: Highway-rail crossing on the right ahead
questions.explanation: This advance warning sign indicates a highway-railroad crossing is located to the right of the road ahead. Drivers should be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Light rail vehicle approaching — do not cross
Light rail station loading zone
Rail vehicle speed zone ahead
Light rail crossing temporarily closed

questions.correctAnswerText: Light rail vehicle approaching — do not cross
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a light rail vehicle is approaching. Drivers and pedestrians must not cross the tracks until the light rail vehicle has passed and signals indicate it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic signal out of order ahead
Railroad crossing ahead with no signal or gate
No stopping permitted near tracks
Abandoned railroad crossing ahead

questions.correctAnswerText: Railroad crossing ahead with no signal or gate
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the railroad crossing ahead does not have automated signals or gates. Drivers must look and listen carefully for approaching trains before crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Left lane closed at railroad crossing
No U-turn at railroad crossing
No left turn across railroad tracks
Left turn signal for trains only

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn across railroad tracks
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits left turns that would cross over railroad tracks. Turning across tracks can be extremely dangerous if a train is approaching.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Steep grade crossing ahead
Uneven road surface at tracks
Speed bump before railroad tracks
Low ground clearance railroad crossing ahead

questions.correctAnswerText: Low ground clearance railroad crossing ahead
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers of vehicles with low ground clearance (trailers, low-riders, etc.) that the railroad crossing may cause their vehicle to get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Bus and rail shared lane ahead
Rail crossing in the right lane
Lane reserved for light rail vehicles only
Light rail station parking ahead

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reserved for light rail vehicles only
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a lane that is exclusively for light rail transit vehicles. Other vehicles are prohibited from using this lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Two parallel roads ahead
Divided highway with rail in median
Railroad tracks run parallel to the road — watch for turns crossing tracks
Side road crosses railroad tracks

questions.correctAnswerText: Railroad tracks run parallel to the road — watch for turns crossing tracks
questions.explanation: This sign warns that railroad tracks run alongside the road and a turn ahead will cross the tracks. Watch carefully for trains when making the turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Railroad crossing ahead — slow down
Tracks are closed for maintenance
Trains may not be running on these tracks
Do not drive on railroad tracks

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not drive on railroad tracks
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits vehicles from driving on railroad tracks. Driving on tracks is illegal and extremely dangerous, as trains cannot stop quickly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Maximum vehicle length allowed on tracks
Shows distance between railroad tracks and a nearby intersection
Speed limit within the rail crossing zone
Distance to the next railroad crossing

questions.correctAnswerText: Shows distance between railroad tracks and a nearby intersection
questions.explanation: This sign indicates the distance between the railroad tracks and a nearby road intersection. It warns drivers that there is limited space between the crossing and the intersection, so avoid stopping on the tracks.
